name: Slendytubbies VS Redux
desc:
Based on Slendytubbies by ZeoWorks

Collect and investigate all 15 Tubby Custards in each area as a Guardian, or quench your thirst for blood as a mutant Slendytubby.

Slendytubbies VS Redux is a remaster of Slendytubbies VS, which I made in 2018. Redux was built from the ground up with a lot of passion and with tons more polish!
